content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments is a crypto payment gateway that allows creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana. By integrating NOWPayments with a static site, creators can bypass traditional payment gateways and enjoy faster settlement times, lower fees, and greater control over their payments. This is especially important for creators in countries where traditional payment gateways are unavailable or restricted.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a NOWPayments-integrated static site involves a combination of tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. When a user purchases a digital product, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which verifies the transaction on the blockchain and triggers a webhook that updates the creator's order storage. The file is then delivered to the user through a cloud storage service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, software, and other digital products and need a reliable payment gateway that can handle a large volume of transactions. It's ideal for creators in countries where Stripe and other major payment gateways are unavailable or restricted, as well as those who want to reduce their reliance on third-party payment processors and enjoy faster settlement times and lower fees.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make up a NOWPayments-integrated static site include: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each of these components plays a critical role in the architecture, allowing creators to receive payments, store orders, and deliver files to their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a NOWPayments-integrated static site today, follow these steps: Sign up for a GitHub account and create a new repository for your site. Choose a hosting plan and configure your GitHub Pages settings. Set up Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic and integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment verification. Configure Supabase for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments with your site and configure your payment settings.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
USDT transactions on Tron and Solana cost under $0.10 per transaction.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a NOWPayments-integrated static site today, follow these steps: Sign up for a GitHub account and create a new repository for your site. Choose a hosting plan and configure your GitHub Pages settings. Set up Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic and integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment verification. Configure Supabase for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments with your site and configure your payment settings. Make sure to test your site thoroughly to ensure that payments are processed correctly and orders are stored accurately.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a webhook in NOWPayments?

To set up a webhook in NOWPayments, go to your dashboard and navigate to the 'Webhooks' section. Click on 'Add Webhook' and enter the URL of your site's webhook endpoint. Choose the event that you want to trigger the webhook, such as 'payment received', and save your changes.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no additional fees for processing USDT payments on Tron and Solana.
Can I use NOWPayments with other payment gateways?
No, NOWPayments is designed to be a standalone payment gateway and cannot be used in conjunction with other payment gateways like Stripe or PayPal.
How do I store orders in Supabase?

To store orders in Supabase, create a new table and set up a schema to store order data, such as customer information and payment details. Use the NOWPayments webhook to update the Supabase table with new order data.
Can I use NOWPayments with a static site hosted on WordPress?
No, NOWPayments is designed to work with static sites hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, not with dynamic sites like WordPress.
NOWPayments processes payments in under 10 seconds compared to 3-5 business days for PayPal.
